old_caption: The video depicts a scene where an elderly man with a long white beard and glasses is reading an open notebook held in his left hand. He is dressed in a formal gray suit and is looking down at the notebook. To his left, a robotic arm with a sleek, modern design and metallic components is holding a white mug. The background is a plain, dark gray, which helps to emphasize the subjects in the foreground. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting the details of both the man and the robotic arm without creating harsh shadows. The man's right hand moves toward the mug and grasps it, indicating interaction. The robotic arm also makes slight positional adjustments. There are no other significant objects or characters in the frame.

caption: The video depicts a white-haired, bearded man in glasses and a gray suit standing at the right against a plain gray studio background, holding an open spiral notebook and reading it. At the left, a dark-gray articulated robot arm with a silver camera-like module holds a white mug by its handle, keeping it extended toward the man. The robot's gripper maintains contact with the handle throughout, and the mug stays level as the man's attention remains on the notebook. The man's right hand, initially hidden behind the page, rises above the notebook and gestures briefly with curled fingers. His hand then moves leftward toward the offered mug, approaching the handle while he continues reading. As the scene progresses, his fingers touch and rest against the mug beside the robot's gripper, without taking it from the arm. A green indicator ring at the robot's wrist glows brightly during most of this motion. The man and robot remain in this ongoing exchange, the notebook still open in his left hand and the mug still held by the machine.

If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.

timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
